purpose: Why-first validation — require justification for every retain and retire decision

retained_objects.why: Enterprise governance and architecture canon hub — the authoritative location for enterprise standards, ADRs, and governance documents
Active operational document store for the publishing pipeline — editorial, production, titles, automation artifacts
Entity-scoped sensitive client records (pre-need, appointments) — must remain isolated from other entities
Foundation division operational site — active programs, grants, and ministry operations
Active ministry collaboration for Agape International Cathedral
Security governance boundary — compliance notebook and security team coordination
Durable authorization boundaries — removing any security group could break role-based access to M365 or Dataverse resources
Each represents a workload identity (Copilot Studio, GitHub OIDC, Dataverse/Power Platform, or Microsoft system). Removing any without a completed dependency audit risks production workflow failure.
Each repo is the authoritative code store for its entity or function. No duplicate or orphan repos identified.

retirement_candidates.why_no_longer_needed: Standalone site with unknown purpose, no Team/Group, no confirmed external audience. Content (Programs & Events) fully preserved in foundation_div.
No active collaboration confirmed since September 2025. Pricing sheets do not require a dedicated Team.
Build artifacts are reproducible from GitHub. SharePoint is not the correct store for version-controlled build outputs.

consolidations.why_better: One governed, Team-connected Foundation site is clearer than two sites with overlapping content and no documented distinction
Single authoritative source prevents version drift. Reference copy at publishing site retains discoverability without authority ambiguity.

anti_patterns_avoided: No deletions proposed solely because a site has 'too many' items or 'low activity'
No mailbox retired solely because usage metrics were unavailable
No Team retired solely because it has few recent posts
Deletion list is empty by design — not as a failure to identify candidates
